name: LOST:SMILE memories + promises
source:
Six Love, One Truth

Hoshimijima—
A beautiful island of stars and sea located at the southern end of Japan.
The island where my father was born and raised.
I was taken here when I was a little, but I don't remember anything at that time.
I was looking at the island, tracing my late father.

LOST:SMILE memories + promises is a pure love story depicting losing and kindness through love with the girls in fictional island in Okinawa, Hoshimijima.
Collecting the "pieces" scattered in the story with the heroines, the main character eventually reaches one truth.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1102410/LOSTSMILE_memories__promises/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
六份爱，一个真相。

星见岛——
位于日本南端、被星辰与大海包围的美丽岛屿。
这是我父亲出生、长大的岛。
我小时候曾被带来这里，却不记得当时发生过什么。
我凝视着这座岛，追寻已故父亲的足迹。

《遗失：微笑——记忆与承诺》是一部纯爱故事，描绘主人公与冲绳虚构岛屿星见岛上的女孩们相识，在爱中经历失去与温柔。
主角与女主角们共同收集散落在故事中的“碎片”，最终抵达一个真相。

（改编自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1102410/LOSTSMILE_memories__promises/]Steam[/url]）
